brief_check.new_brief: An empty room on a dry, sunny day. A tall window with a white frame. The glass is covered on the inside with grey dirt, dust smudges and fingerprints, so it looks cloudy and dirty. A plain white curtain hangs open at one side. No rain, no water drops, no people, no animals. No text.
brief_check.local_model: localBrief in scripts/illustrate.ts drops the sentences that begin with "No" (the exclusion sentence and "No text.") and no mid-sentence ", no" clause is present. What the local model receives is: "An empty room on a dry, sunny day. A tall window with a white frame. The glass is covered on the inside with grey dirt, dust smudges and fingerprints, so it looks cloudy and dirty. A plain white curtain hangs open at one side." The fix therefore does not depend on the negations: the positive wording (empty room, dry sunny day, dirt on the glass) already removes the person and the rain. "No text" is lost for the local model, as for every other brief, and the house prefix carries it.
brief_check.api_engine: The negations are kept for the API fallback. They name things the failed drawings drew (rain, a person), which is the intended use for that engine; the blueprint warning about excluded objects applies to the local model, which does not see them.
brief_check.criterion_1: Criterion 1 needs the learner to see that the window is dirty. A whole pane clouded by grey dirt, dust smudges and fingerprints on a plain window is a clearer picture of that fact than streaks, which the old drawings read as rain.
brief_check.no_leak_or_favour: The brief adds only atmosphere (empty, dry, sunny) and the one panel fact (dirty window). It names no oven, laundry, cleaning tool or action, and does not tell the learner the word or the chore; criterion 1 and the prompt ("Schrijf wat zij vandaag moet doen") still leave the learner to name it. Panels 2 and 3 are unchanged and keep the same structure (one object state each).
brief_check.alt_consistency: The alt "Een raam met veel vuil op het glas." still states exactly the pictured fact. It does not mention the empty room, the sun or the curtain, which are not task facts; no change needed.
brief_check.house_style: No text, no people, one object, flat and low detail. Fingerprints and smudges are fine detail for a flat style; the coordinator's contact-sheet check must confirm the dirt reads as dirt at display size and not as frosted glass or fog.

meaning.situation_summary: A household leaves a note on the kitchen table for Hind, who cleans the home every Thursday while the writer is at work; three pictures show a dirty window, a dirty oven and a basket of laundry next to a washing machine.
meaning.communicative_purpose: The writer lists three chores for today and thanks Hind, so she knows what to do without being met.
meaning.contrivance_check: A note is how one instructs a cleaner who works alone in an empty home; each panel is one chore and the dirty window is a normal one. The empty-room picture adds no off-page event and the first panel no longer pictures a person at a window.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Household to its weekly cleaner: a note on the kitchen table, first name Hind with "Beste Hind" and je-forms, polite requests and thanks. The medium is the natural one when the recipient is alone in the home.
